messages:
Sanjay: Heads-up 9	 need to finalize packaging for the Orbit reference kit going to Cloud Partner marketplace. Must include: terraform module, minimal example, CI smoke checks, listing metadata, and diagrams. Target: internal alpha next Friday.
Amanda: ok. who picks up CI? I can wire GH Actions if someone adds the example configs.
Maria: i'll do the ref-arch doc + two diagrams (logical + ops). will add a tiny YAML with recommended alerts.
Jordan: i'll scaffold the TF module (modules/orbit), add inputs/outputs and an examples/basic folder. will follow our module naming conventions.
Samir: i'll draft marketplace metadata (short description, tags, icons) and validate legal/license bits. will also check region/arch support table.
Amanda: quick GH Actions snippet to run plan+validate early:
```
name: tf-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - name: Init
        run: terraform init -input=false
      - name: Validate
        run: terraform validate
```
Jordan: thanks. i'll add a small test matrix for archs: aws/us-east-1/x86, aws/us-east-1/arm, gcp/us-central1/x86 so we catch Graviton/compat issues.
Maria: for diagrams i'll attach PNG + a tiny mermaid source file. also will include a 'what to watch' observability section: latency SLOs, KV cache hit %, and disk IO for persistence nodes.
Sanjay: compatibility note  we should state minimum terraform version and supported provider versions in README. also include a short migration note for existing customers.
Samir: packaging constraints: screenshots must be scrubbed (no PII), icons follow 64x64 PNG spec, and listing copy <= 200 chars. will post the checklist into the partner tracker.
Amanda: any objections to adding pre-commit hooks with tflint + fmt? i'd like the repo to enforce formatting.
Jordan: no objections. i'll add .pre-commit-config and a small GH Action step to run `terraform fmt -check`.
Maria: timeline sync: today - owners set (done). tomorrow - PRs for initial module + README + metadata draft. Thu - CI matrix + assets. Fri - publish to partner staging and smoke run.
Samir: i'll schedule a 30-min validation window in partner staging Friday morning and invite the list.
Amanda: i'll be the CI/verification sign-off Friday afternoon if everything passes.
Sanjay: perfect. Jordan, can you include examples/complete with optional monitoring integration (Datadog / Prometheus hints)?
Jordan: yes, add a minimal datadog integration example and a note to swap in prometheus if needed.
Samir: also note for marketplace: include an OSS license file and a short contributor guide.
Maria: will prepare diagrams tonight and push to the draft PR.
Amanda: i'll stub the actions tonight so CI runs on the PRs.
cloud-partner-bot: REMINDER: when packaging checklist is uploaded to /partner-artifacts, run `./scripts/marketplace-validate.sh` to auto-verify.
Sanjay: ok, i'll create the tracking ticket and link PRs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Amanda: thanks 1 will ping if i need pairing on the workflow.
Jordan: PR tomorrow. :rocket:
